author: PhatJazz
body:
Hey Avicus people, its been quiet a while and ever since my friends got back into nebula iv'e wanted to play but unfortunately i have been banned for hacking. I am very sorry for this as I was quiet the trouble maker back then. I now realise how hacking makes the game unfair for the others that are playing it. I used to make excuses for hacking because others were also hacking and it wasn't fair. But after much thought i have come to the conclusion that i was only making the hacking community grow by hacking myself thus i have quite my hacking ways and would like to get back onto the glorious server that Avicus is. 
Thank you for your time - BO_b0

title: Appeal for infraction

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Greetings, BO_b0.

I can observe you've been banned for quite an extensive amount of time already, and you haven't attempted to evade your punishment in the meanwhile. For this reason, I'll be appealing your punishment.

That being said, welcome back to the server. I advise you abide by the rules this time. Have fun in-game.

Sincerely,
- Vinnx | Senior Moderator
